integrity_statement: The all-graph proof is explicit. The finite diamond certificate and small-graph computations are reproducibility aids and not substitutes for the unrestricted proof. Prior static VC result is credited to Kozma and Moran.
scientific_limitations: For noncactus graphs the result gives a strict rank-plus-one lower bound, not the exact Littlestone dimension. The graph is finite and simple; edge-direction queries only. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: The cactus boundary for adaptive shattering of acyclic orientations
